thesis: This episode argues that specific technology platforms like AWS and Android have already driven trillions in value, while Tesla is positioned to disrupt the utility industry through integrated solar, storage, and grid management software. The speaker warns that this utility disruption will cause hundreds of billions of dollars of debt to become distressed, leading to bankruptcies among utility companies.
